paragraphs: Hyman mentions him only in Shabbat 45b, where Rabbi Abba and Rabbi Assi came to visit him.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Shabbat 45b explicitly writes Rabbi Abba and Rabbi Assi visiting Rabbi Abba of Haifa.

“Only” is Hyman’s statement about the occurrence, not a new exhaustive search result. In the named William Davidson Shabbat 45b paragraph, Rabbi Abba and Rabbi Assi come to Rabbi Abba of Haifa; the full title is explicit at each corresponding occurrence. The existing note remains unchanged. No further identities or legal material from that paragraph are added.
